_comentario: Datos de origen para tools/gen_palabras.py --libro firstwords («First Words», ver notes/06-first-words.md). Este fichero SÍ se edita a mano; content/firstwords/generated-*.tex NO. Trimestre 3 (primavera), días 131-195: tres palabras al día; llegan las otras formas de escribir los sonidos (ay, ou, ie, ea, oy, ir, ue, aw, ew, oe, au, ey, wh, ph, tch, dge), la e mágica (c-a_e-k) y dos consonantes seguidas (n-e-s-t). Palabras de hasta cinco sonidos. Cada viernes presenta unas pocas tricky words ('tricky'), que se leen enteras: las que llevarán las frases del verano.

actividad.prompt: Amy is eight! She has got a green dress and a badge that says “8 today!” Draw her at her birthday party.
Amy's birthday cake looks like Pip: it is green! Turn the circle into the cake, with eight candles.
Amy's presents: a toy parrot, a purple hat, a book and a drawing of Toby.
the children playing pass the parcel, sitting in a circle.
Draw Amy's party in the garden, full of balloons.
Lucía and Amy paint eggs. One is blue with white spots, and one is yellow with red stripes. Draw them!
the Easter bunny hiding a chocolate egg next to a flowerpot.
Lucía looking up and finding the last egg, on the fence between the two gardens.

actividad.adivinanza: I am small and yellow, I come out of an egg, and I say “cheep, cheep”. What am I?

actividad.prompt: Draw a basket full of Easter eggs, each one painted in a different way.
In the park, Toby sees a red squirrel. The squirrel runs up the tallest tree, and Toby barks at the bottom. Draw them!
Toby runs past the pond and into the bushes, and now he is lost! Turn the wavy lines into the pond and the bushes.
Toby's red ball under the bench, and muddy paw prints next to the pond.
Toby at home again, by the fence -- and Dani hugging him.
Draw Pip with the paper medal that Lucía made for him. Pip is a hero!
Mr Brown is cleaning Pip's cage in the garden, and Pip flies out of the open door! Draw Pip flying over the garden.
Pip on a high branch of the chestnut tree, hiding in the leaves.
the green feather that Lucía finds on the fence: a good clue!

actividad.adivinanza: I have got lots of steps, and Mr Brown climbs up me to get to the high branches. What am I?

actividad.prompt: Draw the poster that Lucía and Amy made: LOST PARROT, with a big picture of Pip.
For Book Day, everyone makes a book, and Amy writes a story about Pip. Draw the cover of her book: Pip in a tall tree, and a dog barking.
On Book Day in England, Amy was a witch. Turn the triangle into a witch's hat!
Lucía's book: Toby runs fast, but he can't catch the squirrels!
Lucía reading a riddle to Amy, and Amy laughing.
Draw the cover of a book that you would like to write.
Marta brings a box with five tiny caterpillars that eat green leaves. They are black, with a yellow stripe. Draw them on a leaf.
the caterpillars hanging from the lid, each one in a hard brown case.
five butterflies drying their orange wings.

actividad.adivinanza: I am tiny, a butterfly puts me on a leaf, and a little caterpillar comes out of me. What am I?

actividad.prompt: Draw the butterflies flying away, and the last one landing on Amy's hair.
Sam has got a new bike! It is red, with a yellow bell and a little basket at the front. Draw it.
Turn the circle into a wheel of Sam's new bike, and then draw the rest of the bike.
Sam on his bike, going round the big tree, and Dani shouting “Go, Sam, go!”
Sam riding round the pond on his own, and his dad clapping.
Draw yourself on a bike. Where are you going?
It is Mother's Day! Dad, Lucía and Dani make Mum a surprise breakfast on a tray: toast like hearts, orange juice and coffee. Draw the tray.
the rose hidden in the fridge -- and Dani nearly telling Mum everything!
the card for Mum: a red flower, a white one and a pink rose, in a blue pot.

actividad.adivinanza: I am brown and crunchy, and you eat me for breakfast. If you forget me, I get black and burnt! What am I?

actividad.prompt: Draw the person who looks after you, doing what they like best.
Today Dani is six! His chocolate cake has got six blue candles and a green dinosaur in the middle. Draw it.
Lucía makes a treasure hunt for Dani. Turn the square into the first card, under his pillow. What does it say?
“These are for you!” Dani's presents: a blue bike and a green jumper with a dinosaur on it.
Dani finding the second card between Dad's socks!
Draw a treasure hunt in your house. Where do you hide the cards?
The two families go to the zoo! They see giraffes, elephants, a hippo and some monkeys. Draw your favourite zoo animal.
the penguins, swimming very quickly in the water. Splash!
the monkeys jumping from rope to rope, and the little one eating a banana.

actividad.adivinanza: I have got no legs, I am long and thin, and I go “Sssss”. What am I?

actividad.prompt: Draw your favourite animal at the zoo, and a grown-up can write its name.
Marta's class goes to a farm. In the pen, there are four goats and three sheep. The cutest goat, Lola, has got brown spots. Draw them.
The gate is open, and the goats are munching the cabbages! Turn the zigzag into the fence of their pen.
the donkey eating a carrot, and a hen with her eggs.
the class singing on the bus -- and Amy singing the loudest!
Draw a farm with all its animals.
It is Sports Day! Lucía and Amy are in the yellow team: yellow T-shirts with a green star, and green caps. Draw them.
the egg-and-spoon race: Lucía walking slowly, with her egg on a spoon.
Dani jumping in his sack, all the way to the finish line!

actividad.adivinanza: I am long and soft, and you wear me round your neck when it is cold. On Sports Day, Marta ties Lucía's leg and Amy's leg together with me! What am I?

actividad.prompt: Draw the medal that says “Winner!” -- and Pip trying to eat it.
The class makes a big card for Marta, with a red heart that says “Thank you, Marta!” and yellow stars around it. Draw it.
It is June, and the little ones sing a song about the summer. Turn the spiral into a big, hot summer sun!
the present for Marta, hidden under her desk: a plant in a pot.
Lucía and Amy by the fence. In August, the Browns are coming to the village!
Draw everything you have learnt to read this spring.
